evidence: Configured branch 3 at VA 0x401f75 invokes 0x401900 and self-delete routine 0x401390. The former creates an HKLM Active Setup GUID/StubPath key (RegSetValueExA at 0x401a4b), reads its own image, patches the copy, writes it with fwrite at 0x401b26, and launches it at 0x401b7e.

Other retained branches extract DLL resource 101 through 0x402460; write LanmanServer Parameters/ServiceDLL at 0x40133e; or create a host process, allocate/write a DLL pathname and pass resolved LoadLibraryA to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d. The self-delete routine builds COMSPEC /c del with its own short path, launches a suspended command processor and resumes it.

Embedded PE at file offset 0x5060 has entry RVA 0x741a filled with zero bytes; its resource/relocation sections are zero too. Surviving Storm ddos banners and STORM message text identify lineage but do not prove working network, DDoS or RAT capability in this damaged DLL. The loader code and unauthorized persistence justify MALICIOUS; retained traits explicitly describe code/API profiles, not successful installation.

Static stripped x86-64 ELF with uClibc. Main at VA 0x405230 initializes a string table, selects daemon-looking names through 0x404fb0, copies a selection over argv[0] at 0x40539e and sets PR_SET_NAME through 0x4053b4. It forks/setsid and closes standard descriptors.

String-table routines 0x408410/0x408490 apply eight 32-bit XOR keys bytewise (effective mask 0x51). Credential reconstruction uses mask 0x22. Decoded configuration includes cnc.notabotnet.lol and a network-order port of 61337, shell/enable negotiation strings, BusyBox probe and a broad IoT default-credential dictionary. No Base64 operation or systemd persistence is established by the encoded systemd path.

The C2 receive path at 0x405b04 swaps a uint16 length and bounds it to 1024, receives through 0x40b44c (recvfrom syscall 45), then passes the body to 0x400410 at 0x405ba1. The parser reads network-order duration, vector, target count, IPv4/netmask entries and attack options. 0x4001c0 forks a timer child that terminates the attack process after the requested duration and dispatches the selected attack callback.

Attack registration at 0x400740 includes vector 9 pointing to 0x403160. This routine opens AF_INET/SOCK_DGRAM/IPPROTO_UDP sockets, binds/connects targets, builds per-target payloads and repeatedly sends via 0x40336c -> 0x40b488 -> syscall 44, with the outer branch at 0x403374 restarting the send loop. This establishes remote flood tasking, not merely socket capability. Scanner entry 0x406690 creates a raw TCP socket and a large connection-state pool; the credential dictionary provides corroborating propagation evidence.

Primary-source comparison: Mirai attack.c defines the matching duration/vector/target/options parser, forked timed attack dispatcher and vector 9 UDP plain attack; main.c defines the matching two-byte length-framed recv/attack_parse handoff. These structural correspondences support Mirai-derived lineage, without assigning an unverified variant name.
